market_question: Will Houston Texans win the 2027 NFL AFC Championship?
reasoning: The Texans have a promising QB in CJ Stroud and a solid coach, but the AFC is loaded with elite, prime-age quarterbacks (Mahomes, Allen, Jackson, Burrow) who have dominated the conference. Even with two seasons to develop, Houston's odds of emerging from that field are closer to 5% than the market-implied 9.5%. The gap exceeds 5 percentage points, making No the cheap side.
evidence_points: Chiefs, Bills, Ravens, and Bengals have all made recent AFC title games and retain core players.
Texans have never reached a Super Bowl; their 2023-24 playoff run ended in the divisional round.
Stroud's 2024 season showed regression in some advanced metrics, and the AFC South alone does not guarantee a deep playoff run.
sources_consulted: NFL standings and playoff results (2023-2024 seasons)
General team strength assessments from major sports outlets
